long_biography.plain_text:
Rudolf Sekušak began operating the Zagorje Gradnja building trade in 1977, creating the base from which a limited company emerged two decades later. Established at that point, Zagorje Gradnja developed around civil-engineering work and construction machinery. Sekušak served as a director through 2015, guiding its formation and long-term growth. He remains an owner of the Croatian contractor.

After leaving the directorship, Sekušak became the company's procurist, retaining a formal role in its representation while Marko Sekušak serves as director. The business works across roads and motorways, earthworks, drainage, demolition, geotechnical projects and sports grounds. Its featured projects also include industrial facilities and major transport infrastructure, reflecting the heavy-civil focus that has defined Sekušak's business career.
